_meta.note: weights_leak reported separately, excluded from total

weight_read_modes.resident: weights spatially expanded; a synaptic operation costs only E_AC (Dampfhoffer 2023, L2372)
weight_read_modes.sram: weights resident in SRAM; every synaptic operation also pays one E_access (10 pJ) to read its 32-bit weight. This is an UPPER bound: weight reuse would divide it.
weight_read_modes.fields: total / ts_share = resident; total_sram / ts_share_sram = weights in SRAM
